title: Titanium Main Pivot Axle
function: Full-suspension main pivot hollow axle 15mm OD
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Main Pivot Axle because its 900+ MPa tensile strength allows thin-wall tube shaping without buckling, critical for lightweight frame and component structures. The alpha-beta microstructure delivers 45% higher specific strength than 4140 chromoly steel, translating directly to gram-level weight savings where it matters. Its high-cycle fatigue endurance limit (>500 MPa @10^7 cycles) matches the pedaling load spectrum of Full-suspension main pivot hollow axle 15mm OD. This rationale is driven by full-suspension main pivot hollow axle 15mm od and service environment demands.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for suspension hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g at 200W fiber laser
Go/No-Go ring gauging at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for fullsuspension main pivot application
commonFailures: Bearing race brinelling from over-torque - avoided by torque-limiting press-fit tool with ±2% accuracy — critical for fullsuspension main pivot performance

faq.q: Does Titanium Main Pivot Axle require special assembly or anti-seize?
faq.a: Yes. Titanium-to-titanium threaded interfaces on Titanium Main Pivot Axle are susceptible to galling (cold welding) during assembly. Application of MoS₂ or copper-based anti-seize compound to all threaded contact surfaces is mandatory. Lubricated installation torque values are typically 15-20% lower than dry values. Thread engagement should not exceed 3× thread diameter.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Main Pivot Axle?
faq.a: Each Titanium Main Pivot Axle shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for fullsuspension main pivot.
